The edge‑gateway rate‑limiter was set to **100 requests per second per pod** (three Envoy pods → ≈ 300 req/s total).  
When the March 10 2026 marketing campaign pushed traffic up to ~420 req/s, the per‑pod limit was exceeded and each pod returned `429 EDGE‑RL01`.

The fix was to **raise the limit to 250 requests per second per pod** (≈ 750 req/s total) by updating the `edge‑gateway‑envoy` ConfigMap and performing a rolling restart of the edge‑gateway pods. After the restart the `429` errors stopped.

**done**
